Attend customer calls and provide technical support. Troubleshoot software-related issues. Assist with software installation and configuration. Provide remote support to customers. Escalate unresolved issues to the technical team. Maintain support tickets and customer records.

Any Graduate / BCA / B.E. / B.Tech
  
  
**Experience**
Freshers or 0–1 years of experience.
  
  
Languages: Hindi & English
